briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid rising compute constraints

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue aggressive scaling with o4 and Gemini 3 releases driving benchmark gains. Geopolitical tensions over chip exports intensify while safety frameworks lag deployment pace. Prompt injection and multi-agent coordination remain core unsolved risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration achieving 87% on GAIA. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Meta's Llama 4 405B followed within days, while xAI and DeepSeek released competitive open weights variants.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST and EU AI Office issued joint guidance on agentic system audits this week.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA and Google. Microsoft and CoreWeave announced $4B joint data center expansion in Texas targeting 100k H100-equivalent GPUs by Q2 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization or compute asymmetry determine the 2027 AGI leader?
